full_page.content:
July 13 - July 18
Page 158 July 13 James Tuohy - Ypsilanti - 6 - Lwukemia - Ann Arbor authorities sent him home after two holpless.
Patrick H. Diskin - 19 - marine in southern Pacific Service - has not been heard from middle May.
Wm Tuhonen - 35 - indiferent to practice of religion. - conse- quently his wife and children - wife discouraged ...
Charles Du Chene - 62 - of Marine City - Sister phones "Spinal maningitis - Drs. give little hope of recovery - Enrolled % phone at 9:25 P.M.
Norbert Milewicz - 12 - gland development abnormely slow. Annie O'Neill - 70 - of Montreal - cancer inward
Page 159 July 24
Mrs. Ellen Casey - 83 - heart-trouble and childish .... wants to die Annobell Pittman - 19 - spinal maningitis - in Kiefer's ....
Mrs. Fred Miller - 52 - Cancer and bed sores - arm fearfully swolen
Thanks Lora May Ireland - 7 - peculiarly stiff neck - was prayed for and enrolled. Her father a bitter non catholic. Child now O.K. and Father figuering on becoming Catholic.
25 Peter Rath - bad hernia and fearful indigestion ... 16 days without any nourishment Aug. 19 here in perfect health.
Earl Demaray - 25 - nerveous break .... insanity feared.
Felice Marie Galorneau - 35 lost one of her little twins and has had blood poison and nerveous.
Mrs. Mary Berra - 32 - nerveous and heart- trouble
26 Jerry Steiger - bitten by dog ..
Page 160 July 27 Thanks ..... Mrs. Mabel R. Harris - 50 - breast removed two yrs. ago. Cancer went to spine and belvis eating bones in bad shape. Drs had lost all hope of recovery ........ Her brother in law promised the Good God to give up smoking etc, etc. She has astonished the Drs. .... is doing her own house.
27 Mrs. Delia M. Walker - 25 - T.B. in both lungs .... just married in January.
